project.name: DemoOpenColl_New
project.output: Literature review subsection titled Using AI to Proxy Communication.
project.audience: Readers of a broader paper on AI-mediated collaboration
project.collaborationMode: OpenCollab parent repo stays local; the task folder stores the task brief and JSON dataset.

brief.assignment: Write a concise literature review subsection explaining how AI systems stand in for, filter, summarize, translate, rephrase, or coordinate communication between people, while distinguishing proxy communication from ordinary individual writing assistance.
finalDeliverables: Discussion of communication breakdowns and risks
Citations or evidence notes linked to a lightweight literature matrix
Final integration pass aligning definitions, evidence, and claims
constraints: Claims in the draft must trace back to the source matrix.
Definitions must stay consistent across notes and draft text.
Writing boundaries should be visible because multiple writers may touch the same draft surface.
The cloud repo should remain lightweight and maintain only the brief plus OpenCollab JSON dataset.

members.focus: section outline, integration, and final merge

workPackages.title: Scope Definition
workPackages.brief: Working definition, boundary with individual writing assistance, scope tests, and handoff notes drafted for team review.

classificationHints: Use dependency edges when one artifact must exist before another can be accurate.
Use boundary edges when two owners touch the same concept, claim, file, or interface.
Use sync edges when active tasks need a short alignment meeting.
